package postgres

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
)

var _ repository.PlanningSnapshotReader = (*LearningJourneyRepoPG)(nil)

// ReadPlanningSnapshot observes only Student-owned facts in one PostgreSQL
// snapshot. It never reserves, locks for mutation, writes a receipt, or contacts
// Course/Practice/Runtime. Capture time is observation provenance, not a revision.
func (repo *LearningJourneyRepoPG) ReadPlanningSnapshot(ctx context.Context, studentID, pathID string, targets []domain.LearningTargetRef) (domain.PlanningSnapshotSource, error) {
	if repo == nil || repo.Pool == nil {
		return domain.PlanningSnapshotSource{}, errors.New("learning journey repository pool is required")
	}
	if !domain.IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(studentID) || !domain.IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(pathID) {
		return domain.PlanningSnapshotSource{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	normalized, e := domain.NormalizePlanningSnapshotTargets(targets)
	if e != nil {
		return domain.PlanningSnapshotSource{}, e
	}
	tx, e := repo.Pool.BeginTx(ctx, pgx.TxOptions{IsoLevel: pgx.RepeatableRead, AccessMode: pgx.ReadOnly})
	if e != nil {
		return domain.PlanningSnapshotSource{}, e
	}
	defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback(ctx) }()
	source, e := readPlanningSnapshotSource(ctx, tx, studentID, pathID, normalized)
	if e != nil {
		return domain.PlanningSnapshotSource{}, e
	}
	if e = tx.Commit(ctx); e != nil {
		return domain.PlanningSnapshotSource{}, e
	}
	return source, nil
}

func readPlanningSnapshotSource(ctx context.Context, q learningPathQuerier, studentID, pathID string, targets []domain.LearningTargetRef) (domain.PlanningSnapshotSource, error) {
	source := domain.PlanningSnapshotSource{StudentID: studentID, RequestedTargets: targets}
	path, e := readPlanningSnapshotPath(ctx, q, studentID, pathID)
	if e != nil {
		return source, e
	}
	source.Path = path
	source.Context, e = getLearningContext(ctx, q, studentID, false)
	if e != nil {
		return source, e
	}
	source.Path.IsSelected = source.Context.SelectedLearningPathID == path.ID
	source.Profile, e = scanStudentOnboarding(q.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT `+studentOnboardingColumns+` FROM student_onboarding WHERE student_id=$1`, studentID))
	if errors.Is(e, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		return source, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	if e != nil {
		return source, e
	}
	source.Profile.GoalText = "" // free-form declarations are not planning snapshot metadata
	if e = q.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT transaction_timestamp()`).Scan(&source.CapturedAt); e != nil {
		return source, e
	}
	source.CapturedAt = source.CapturedAt.UTC()
	source.PendingIntent, e = readPlanningSnapshotIntent(ctx, q, studentID, pathID, path.Version)
	if e != nil {
		return source, e
	}
	budget := planningSnapshotReadBudget{}
	if e = budget.add(source); e != nil {
		return source, e
	}
	source.Mastery, e = readPlanningSnapshotMastery(ctx, q, studentID, targets, &budget)
	if e != nil {
		return source, e
	}
	source.Evidence, e = readPlanningSnapshotEvidence(ctx, q, studentID, targets, &budget)
	if e != nil {
		return source, e
	}
	source.ActivityFacts, e = readPlanningSnapshotFacts(ctx, q, path, &budget)
	if e != nil {
		return source, e
	}
	source.CourseBindings, e = readPlanningSnapshotCourseBindings(ctx, q, path, &budget)
	if e != nil {
		return source, e
	}
	source.PracticeBindings, e = readPlanningSnapshotPracticeBindings(ctx, q, path, &budget)
	if e != nil {
		return source, e
	}
	raw, e := json.Marshal(source)
	if e != nil {
		return source, e
	}
	if len(raw) > domain.MaximumPlanningSnapshotPayloadBytes {
		return source, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return source, nil
}

// This exact current-revision learner intent is observed in the same owner
// transaction as path, profile and evidence. Historical/stale/consumed intents
// cannot authorize the current snapshot. Migration032 is a rollout prerequisite.
func readPlanningSnapshotIntent(ctx context.Context, q learningPathQuerier, studentID, pathID string, revision int64) (*domain.HybridLearningIntentProjection, error) {
	rows, err := q.Query(ctx, `SELECT intent_id::text,student_id::text,learning_path_id::text,expected_path_revision,projection_json FROM student_learning_intent WHERE student_id=$1 AND learning_path_id=$2 AND expected_path_revision=$3 AND consumed_at IS NULL ORDER BY intent_id LIMIT 2`, studentID, pathID, revision)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	var result *domain.HybridLearningIntentProjection
	for rows.Next() {
		if result != nil {
			return nil, domain.ErrConflict
		}
		var id, sid, pid string
		var expected int64
		var raw []byte
		if err := rows.Scan(&id, &sid, &pid, &expected, &raw); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if len(raw) > domain.MaximumPlanningSnapshotRequestBytes {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		var intent domain.HybridLearningIntentProjection
		decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
		decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
		if decoder.Decode(&intent) != nil || decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}) != io.EOF || intent.IntentID != id || intent.StudentID != sid || intent.LearningPathID != pid || intent.ExpectedPathRevision != expected || domain.ValidateHybridLearningIntent(intent) != nil {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		result = &intent
	}
	return result, rows.Err()
}

// Reuse the existing header scanner/normalizer, but whitelist item columns:
// neither lesson_content_json nor task/answer content is needed for this read.
func readPlanningSnapshotPath(ctx context.Context, q learningPathQuerier, studentID, pathID string) (domain.StudentLearningPath, error) {
	p, e := scanLearningPath(q.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT `+learningPathColumns+` FROM student_learning_path WHERE student_id=$1 AND id=$2`, studentID, pathID))
	if errors.Is(e, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		return p, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	if e != nil {
		return p, e
	}
	rows, e := q.Query(ctx, `SELECT reference_type,reference_id,position,status,targets_json,reason_code,id::text,COALESCE(lesson_revision_id::text,''),frozen_requirements FROM student_learning_path_item WHERE student_learning_path_id=$1 ORDER BY position`, pathID)
	if e != nil {
		return p, e
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	bytesRead := 0
	for rows.Next() {
		var i domain.LearningPathItem
		var targets, requirements []byte
		if e = rows.Scan(&i.ReferenceType, &i.ReferenceID, &i.Position, &i.Status, &targets, &i.ReasonCode, &i.ID, &i.LessonRevisionID, &requirements); e != nil {
			return p, e
		}
		bytesRead += len(targets) + len(requirements)
		if bytesRead > domain.MaximumPlanningSnapshotPayloadBytes {
			return p, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if json.Unmarshal(targets, &i.Targets) != nil || json.Unmarshal(requirements, &i.FrozenRequirements) != nil {
			return p, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		p.Items = append(p.Items, i)
	}
	if e = rows.Err(); e != nil {
		return p, e
	}
	normalized, e := domain.NormalizeStudentLearningPath(p)
	if e != nil {
		return p, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return normalized, nil
}

type planningSnapshotReadBudget struct{ bytes int }

func (b *planningSnapshotReadBudget) add(v any) error {
	raw, e := json.Marshal(v)
	if e != nil {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	b.bytes += len(raw) + 2
	if b.bytes > domain.MaximumPlanningSnapshotPayloadBytes {
		return fmt.Errorf("planning snapshot payload exceeds technical byte bound: %w", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	return nil
}

const planningSnapshotRequestedCTE = `WITH requested AS (SELECT item->>'type' AS type,item->>'key' AS key,COALESCE(item->>'version','') AS version FROM jsonb_array_elements($2::jsonb) AS item) `

func readPlanningSnapshotMastery(ctx context.Context, q learningPathQuerier, studentID string, targets []domain.LearningTargetRef, b *planningSnapshotReadBudget) ([]domain.StudentTargetMastery, error) {
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(targets)
	rows, e := q.Query(ctx, planningSnapshotRequestedCTE+`SELECT m.student_id,m.target_type,m.target_key,m.target_version,m.state,m.mastery_score,m.confidence,m.independent_success_count,m.assisted_success_count,m.failure_count,m.evidence_count,m.last_seen_at,m.last_practiced_at,m.last_failed_at,m.policy_version FROM student_target_mastery m JOIN requested r ON r.type=m.target_type AND r.key=m.target_key AND r.version=m.target_version WHERE m.student_id=$1 ORDER BY m.target_type,m.target_key,m.target_version`, studentID, string(raw))
	if e != nil {
		return nil, e
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	byTarget := map[string]domain.StudentTargetMastery{}
	for rows.Next() {
		m, e := scanTargetMastery(rows)
		if e != nil {
			return nil, e
		}
		byTarget[planningSnapshotTargetID(m.Target)] = m
	}
	if e = rows.Err(); e != nil {
		return nil, e
	}
	result := make([]domain.StudentTargetMastery, 0, len(targets))
	for _, r := range targets {
		m, ok := byTarget[planningSnapshotTargetID(r)]
		if !ok {
			m = domain.StudentTargetMastery{StudentID: studentID, Target: r, State: domain.TargetMasteryUnknown, PolicyVersion: domain.MasteryPolicyVersion}
		}
		if e = b.add(m); e != nil {
			return nil, e
		}
		result = append(result, m)
	}
	return result, nil
}

func readPlanningSnapshotEvidence(ctx context.Context, q learningPathQuerier, studentID string, targets []domain.LearningTargetRef, b *planningSnapshotReadBudget) ([]domain.PlanningEvidenceReference, error) {
	raw, _ := json.Marshal(targets)
	// Both complete histories are selected by learner+requested target, never by
	// the current path or a "recent" LIMIT. Raw evidence scores/bodies stay local.
	rows, e := q.Query(ctx, planningSnapshotRequestedCTE+`SELECT e.learning_action_id::text,e.task_id::text,e.target_type,e.target_key,e.target_version,e.evidence_class,e.outcome,e.support_context,e.evidence_kind,e.hints_used,e.max_hint_level,e.intervention_used,e.teacher_policy_version,e.mastery_policy_version,e.occurred_at,
 COALESCE(a.student_id=e.student_id AND a.task_id=e.task_id AND a.source_kind='course_answer' AND a.closed_at IS NOT NULL AND a.outcome=e.outcome AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(a.learning_targets) t WHERE t->>'type'=e.target_type AND t->>'key'=e.target_key AND COALESCE(t->>'version','')=e.target_version),false)
 FROM student_learning_action_target_evidence e JOIN requested r ON r.type=e.target_type AND r.key=e.target_key AND r.version=e.target_version LEFT JOIN student_learning_action a ON a.id=e.learning_action_id WHERE e.student_id=$1 ORDER BY e.learning_action_id,e.target_type,e.target_key,e.target_version`, studentID, string(raw))
	if e != nil {
		return nil, e
	}
	result := []domain.PlanningEvidenceReference{}
	for rows.Next() {
		var x domain.PlanningEvidenceReference
		var hint sql.NullInt32
		var valid bool
		x.SourceKind = "course_answer"
		x.StudentID = studentID
		if e = rows.Scan(&x.EvidenceID, &x.TaskID, &x.Target.Type, &x.Target.Key, &x.Target.Version, &x.EvidenceClass, &x.Outcome, &x.SupportContext, &x.Kind, &x.HintsUsed, &hint, &x.InterventionUsed, &x.TeacherPolicyVersion, &x.MasteryPolicyVersion, &x.OccurredAt, &valid); e != nil {
			rows.Close()
			return nil, e
		}
		if !valid {
			rows.Close()
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		x.LearningActionID = x.EvidenceID
		if hint.Valid {
			v := int(hint.Int32)
			x.MaxHintLevel = &v
		}
		x.OccurredAt = x.OccurredAt.UTC()
		if e = b.add(x); e != nil {
			rows.Close()
			return nil, e
		}
		result = append(result, x)
	}
	e = rows.Err()
	rows.Close()
	if e != nil {
		return nil, e
	}
	rows, e = q.Query(ctx, planningSnapshotRequestedCTE+`SELECT e.evidence_id::text,COALESCE(p.learning_action_id::text,''),e.task_instance_id::text,p.task_revision_id::text,p.submission_id::text,e.target_type,e.target_key,e.target_version,p.outcome,e.support_context,e.evidence_kind,p.hints_used,p.max_hint_level,p.teacher_assistance_used,p.assistance_policy_version,e.occurred_at,p.request_hash,p.policy_version,COALESCE(a.surface_classification,''),
 COALESCE(p.student_id=e.student_id AND p.task_instance_id=e.task_instance_id AND p.submission_id=p.evidence_id AND (p.learning_action_id IS NULL OR (a.student_id=e.student_id AND a.source_kind='practice_v2' AND a.practice_task_instance_id=e.task_instance_id AND a.practice_task_revision_id=p.task_revision_id AND a.lifecycle_status='CLOSED')),false)
 FROM student_practice_target_evidence e JOIN requested r ON r.type=e.target_type AND r.key=e.target_key AND r.version=e.target_version LEFT JOIN student_practice_evidence_receipt p ON p.evidence_id=e.evidence_id LEFT JOIN student_learning_action a ON a.id=p.learning_action_id WHERE e.student_id=$1 ORDER BY e.evidence_id,e.target_type,e.target_key,e.target_version`, studentID, string(raw))
	if e != nil {
		return nil, e
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	for rows.Next() {
		var x domain.PlanningEvidenceReference
		var hint sql.NullInt32
		var valid bool
		var policy string
		x.EvidenceClass = domain.LearningEvidenceApplication
		x.StudentID = studentID
		x.MasteryPolicyVersion = domain.MasteryPolicyVersion
		if e = rows.Scan(&x.EvidenceID, &x.LearningActionID, &x.TaskInstanceID, &x.TaskRevisionID, &x.SubmissionID, &x.Target.Type, &x.Target.Key, &x.Target.Version, &x.Outcome, &x.SupportContext, &x.Kind, &x.HintsUsed, &hint, &x.InterventionUsed, &x.TeacherPolicyVersion, &x.OccurredAt, &x.ReceiptHash, &policy, &x.SurfaceClassification, &valid); e != nil {
			return nil, e
		}
		if !valid {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		switch policy {
		case domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidencePolicyV2:
			x.SourceKind = "practice_v2"
		case "practice-competency-evidence-v1":
			x.SourceKind = "practice_legacy"
		default:
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if hint.Valid {
			v := int(hint.Int32)
			x.MaxHintLevel = &v
		}
		x.OccurredAt = x.OccurredAt.UTC()
		if e = b.add(x); e != nil {
			return nil, e
		}
		result = append(result, x)
	}
	return result, rows.Err()
}

func readPlanningSnapshotFacts(ctx context.Context, q learningPathQuerier, path domain.StudentLearningPath, b *planningSnapshotReadBudget) ([]domain.LessonActivityFact, error) {
	rows, e := q.Query(ctx, `SELECT f.source_type,f.fact_id::text,f.student_id::text,f.item_id::text,f.requirement_id::text,f.occurred_at FROM student_lesson_activity_fact f JOIN student_learning_path_item i ON i.id=f.item_id WHERE i.student_learning_path_id=$1 ORDER BY f.source_type,f.fact_id`, path.ID)
	if e != nil {
		return nil, e
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	result := []domain.LessonActivityFact{}
	for rows.Next() {
		var f domain.LessonActivityFact
		if e = rows.Scan(&f.Type, &f.FactID, &f.StudentID, &f.ItemID, &f.RequirementID, &f.OccurredAt); e != nil {
			return nil, e
		}
		f.OccurredAt = f.OccurredAt.UTC()
		f, e = planningSnapshotFactWithRequirement(path, f)
		if e != nil {
			return nil, e
		}
		if e = b.add(f); e != nil {
			return nil, e
		}
		result = append(result, f)
	}
	return result, rows.Err()
}
func planningSnapshotFactWithRequirement(path domain.StudentLearningPath, f domain.LessonActivityFact) (domain.LessonActivityFact, error) {
	if f.StudentID != path.StudentID || !domain.IsCanonicalPracticeLearningActionUUID(f.FactID) || f.OccurredAt.IsZero() {
		return f, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	for _, i := range path.Items {
		if i.ID != f.ItemID {
			continue
		}
		for _, r := range i.FrozenRequirements {
			if r.ID == f.RequirementID && r.Type == f.Type && r.Satisfied {
				f.SourceID = r.SourceReference.ID
				f.SourceRevisionID = r.SourceReference.RevisionID
				return f, nil
			}
		}
	}
	return f, domain.ErrValidation
}

func readPlanningSnapshotCourseBindings(ctx context.Context, q learningPathQuerier, path domain.StudentLearningPath, b *planningSnapshotReadBudget) ([]domain.PlanningCourseActionBinding, error) {
	rows, e := q.Query(ctx, `SELECT a.id::text,a.student_id::text,a.student_task_answer_id::text,a.task_id::text,COALESCE(a.learning_path_item_id::text,''),COALESCE(a.requirement_id::text,''),a.lifecycle_status,a.learning_targets,a.opened_at,a.closed_at,n.status,
 COALESCE(a.student_id=n.student_id AND a.task_id=n.task_id AND a.learning_path_item_id=n.learning_path_item_id AND a.requirement_id=n.requirement_id,false)
 FROM student_learning_action a LEFT JOIN student_task_answer n ON n.id=a.student_task_answer_id WHERE a.source_kind='course_answer' AND (a.learning_path_item_id IN (SELECT id FROM student_learning_path_item WHERE student_learning_path_id=$1) OR n.learning_path_item_id IN (SELECT id FROM student_learning_path_item WHERE student_learning_path_id=$1)) ORDER BY a.id`, path.ID)
	if e != nil {
		return nil, e
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	result := []domain.PlanningCourseActionBinding{}
	for rows.Next() {
		var x domain.PlanningCourseActionBinding
		var raw []byte
		var valid bool
		if e = rows.Scan(&x.LearningActionID, &x.StudentID, &x.AnswerID, &x.TaskID, &x.LearningPathItemID, &x.RequirementID, &x.LifecycleStatus, &raw, &x.OpenedAt, &x.ClosedAt, &x.AnswerStatus, &valid); e != nil {
			return nil, e
		}
		if !valid || x.StudentID != path.StudentID {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if json.Unmarshal(raw, &x.LearningTargets) != nil {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		x.OpenedAt = x.OpenedAt.UTC()
		if x.ClosedAt != nil {
			v := x.ClosedAt.UTC()
			x.ClosedAt = &v
		}
		if !planningSnapshotCourseBindingMatches(path, x) {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if e = b.add(x); e != nil {
			return nil, e
		}
		result = append(result, x)
	}
	return result, rows.Err()
}
func planningSnapshotCourseBindingMatches(path domain.StudentLearningPath, x domain.PlanningCourseActionBinding) bool {
	for _, i := range path.Items {
		if i.ID != x.LearningPathItemID {
			continue
		}
		for _, r := range i.FrozenRequirements {
			if r.ID == x.RequirementID && (r.Type == "quiz_passed" || r.Type == "task_passed") && r.SourceReference.ID == x.TaskID {
				return true
			}
		}
	}
	return false
}
func readPlanningSnapshotPracticeBindings(ctx context.Context, q learningPathQuerier, path domain.StudentLearningPath, b *planningSnapshotReadBudget) ([]domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding, error) {
	rows, e := q.Query(ctx, `SELECT practice_task_instance_id::text FROM student_learning_action WHERE source_kind='practice_v2' AND learning_path_id=$1 ORDER BY id`, path.ID)
	if e != nil {
		return nil, e
	}
	instances := []string{}
	for rows.Next() {
		var id string
		if e = rows.Scan(&id); e != nil {
			rows.Close()
			return nil, e
		}
		instances = append(instances, id)
		if len(instances)*36 > domain.MaximumPlanningSnapshotPayloadBytes {
			rows.Close()
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
	}
	e = rows.Err()
	rows.Close()
	if e != nil {
		return nil, e
	}
	result := []domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding{}
	for _, id := range instances {
		x, e := getPracticeLearningAction(ctx, q, "student_instance", path.StudentID+"\x00"+id, false)
		if e != nil {
			return nil, e
		}
		include, err := planningSnapshotCurrentPracticeBinding(path, x)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if !include {
			continue
		}
		if e = b.add(x); e != nil {
			return nil, e
		}
		result = append(result, x)
	}
	return result, nil
}
func planningSnapshotPracticeBindingMatches(path domain.StudentLearningPath, x domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding) bool {
	if x.StudentID != path.StudentID || x.LearningPathID != path.ID {
		return false
	}
	active := x.LifecycleStatus == domain.PracticeLearningActionReserved || x.LifecycleStatus == domain.PracticeLearningActionOpen
	for _, i := range path.Items {
		if active && i.Position != x.LearningPathPositionReservation {
			continue
		}
		if x.LearningPathItemID != "" {
			if i.ID != x.LearningPathItemID {
				continue
			}
			for _, r := range i.FrozenRequirements {
				if r.ID == x.RequirementID && r.Type == "practice_completed" && r.SourceReference.ID == x.TaskRevisionID && r.SourceReference.RevisionID == x.TaskRevisionID {
					return true
				}
			}
		} else if i.ReferenceType == "practice" && i.ReferenceID == x.TaskRevisionID {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
func planningSnapshotTargetID(r domain.LearningTargetRef) string {
	return string(r.Type) + "\x00" + r.Key + "\x00" + r.Version
}

// Terminal detached history is not current protected work. Its relevant mastery
// history still participates independently in complete requested evidence refs.
// Active work is never silently discarded by this current-projection filter.
func planningSnapshotCurrentPracticeBinding(path domain.StudentLearningPath, x domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding) (bool, error) {
	if x.StudentID != path.StudentID || x.LearningPathID != path.ID {
		return false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	switch x.LifecycleStatus {
	case domain.PracticeLearningActionReserved, domain.PracticeLearningActionOpen:
		if !planningSnapshotPracticeBindingMatches(path, x) {
			return false, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		return true, nil
	case domain.PracticeLearningActionClosed, domain.PracticeLearningActionCancelled:
		return planningSnapshotPracticeBindingMatches(path, x), nil
	default:
		return false, domain.ErrValidation
	}
}
